goal: Provide a standalone DingTalk reimbursement review bot that reads approval nodes and attachments, performs local invoice OCR and historical/new invoice deduplication, and always leaves uncertain cases for human finance review.

acceptance_criteria.description: The first interface test authenticates the DingTalk app, lists instances for the configured reimbursement process, and reads at most one sample approval detail without executing or changing any approval task.
The capability report never returns an app secret or access token and reports missing attachment, OCR, reviewer, and duplicate-ledger prerequisites explicitly.
Approval Stream events are deduplicated and only matching process instance events trigger an initial review.

runtime_policy.ocr_data_policy: Invoice bytes are sent only to the configured local or intranet OCR endpoint.
runtime_policy.approval_policy: The capability probe and initial review do not agree or reject a real DingTalk approval.
runtime_policy.human_review_policy: Missing attachments, OCR failures, amount mismatches, duplicates, and uncertain results remain pending for a finance reviewer.
